name: stringconcat1.k
model:
class StringConcat1 {
  first:String
  second:String
  combined:String

  req first = "Hello"

  req second = "World"

  req combined = first + " " + second

  req combined = "Hello World"
  dir:String
  file:String
  path:String

  req dir = "/home/user"

  req file = "document.txt"

  req path = dir + "/" + file

  req path = "/home/user/document.txt"
}

main:StringConcat1
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (main Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((StringConcat1 (mk-StringConcat1 (first String)(second String)(combined String)(dir String)(file String)(path String)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-StringConcat1 (sel-StringConcat1 StringConcat1))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-StringConcat1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-StringConcat1 (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-StringConcat1 ((this Ref)) StringConcat1
  (sel-StringConcat1 (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-StringConcat1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-StringConcat1 this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.main: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!main ((this Ref)) Ref
  (main (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ------------------------------------
;   Getters for class StringConcat1:
; ------------------------------------

; --- getters for StringConcat1.first: ---

(define-fun StringConcat1!first ((this Ref)) String
  (first (deref-StringConcat1 this))
)

; --- getters for StringConcat1.second: ---

(define-fun StringConcat1!second ((this Ref)) String
  (second (deref-StringConcat1 this))
)

; --- getters for StringConcat1.combined: ---

(define-fun StringConcat1!combined ((this Ref)) String
  (combined (deref-StringConcat1 this))
)

; --- getters for StringConcat1.dir: ---

(define-fun StringConcat1!dir ((this Ref)) String
  (dir (deref-StringConcat1 this))
)

; --- getters for StringConcat1.file: ---

(define-fun StringConcat1!file ((this Ref)) String
  (file (deref-StringConcat1 this))
)

; --- getters for StringConcat1.path: ---

(define-fun StringConcat1!path ((this Ref)) String
  (path (deref-StringConcat1 this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-StringConcat1 (TopLevelDeclarations!main this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))



; --------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class StringConcat1:
; --------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-StringConcat1 StringConcat1)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun StringConcat1.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringConcat1!first this) "Hello")
)

(assert (! (StringConcat1.inv1 1) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun StringConcat1.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringConcat1!second this) "World")
)

(assert (! (StringConcat1.inv2 1) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun StringConcat1.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringConcat1!combined this) (str.++ (str.++ (StringConcat1!first this) " ") (StringConcat1!second this)))
)

(assert (! (StringConcat1.inv3 1) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun StringConcat1.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringConcat1!combined this) "Hello World")
)

(assert (! (StringConcat1.inv4 1) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun StringConcat1.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringConcat1!dir this) "/home/user")
)

(assert (! (StringConcat1.inv5 1) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Invariant 6: ---

(define-fun StringConcat1.inv6 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringConcat1!file this) "document.txt")
)

(assert (! (StringConcat1.inv6 1) :named _xkassert6))

; --- Invariant 7: ---

(define-fun StringConcat1.inv7 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringConcat1!path this) (str.++ (str.++ (StringConcat1!dir this) "/") (StringConcat1!file this)))
)

(assert (! (StringConcat1.inv7 1) :named _xkassert7))

; --- Invariant 8: ---

(define-fun StringConcat1.inv8 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringConcat1!path this) "/home/user/document.txt")
)

(assert (! (StringConcat1.inv8 1) :named _xkassert8))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-StringConcat1 const-1-StringConcat1))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-1-StringConcat1 () StringConcat1
  (mk-StringConcat1 "Hello"
                  "World"
                  "Hello World"
                  "/home/user"
                  "document.txt"
                  "/home/user/document.txt"))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1))
(define-fun _xkassert7 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (str.++ (dir (sel-StringConcat1 (select heap 1)))
                   "/"
                   (file (sel-StringConcat1 (select heap 1))))))
  (= (path (sel-StringConcat1 (select heap 1))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (= (second (sel-StringConcat1 (select heap 1))) "World"))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (= (dir (sel-StringConcat1 (select heap 1))) "/home/user"))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (main (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-StringConcat1 a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert8 () Bool
  (= (path (sel-StringConcat1 (select heap 1))) "/home/user/document.txt"))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (str.++ (first (sel-StringConcat1 (select heap 1)))
                   " "
                   (second (sel-StringConcat1 (select heap 1))))))
  (= (combined (sel-StringConcat1 (select heap 1))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (= (first (sel-StringConcat1 (select heap 1))) "Hello"))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (= (file (sel-StringConcat1 (select heap 1))) "document.txt"))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (= (combined (sel-StringConcat1 (select heap 1))) "Hello World"))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
              0
              (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1)))
       1
       (lift-StringConcat1
         (mk-StringConcat1 "Hello"
                           "World"
                           "Hello World"
                           "/home/user"
                           "document.txt"
                           "/home/user/document.txt"))))
